text:
Sapporo's winter lights began in 1981
with about 1,000 bulbs.
This December they share Odori Park
with a German Christmas market 👇

🤔 Guess what's new this year, then check 👉 https://japanbystation.com/sapporo-in-december-2026

🎄 The Munich Christmas Market, 25th year.
11:00–21:00 daily, last order 20:45.
Every stall takes cards.

✨ Odori Park is lit until 25 December.
Ekimae-dori stays lit until 11 February.

🆕 From 9 to 28 January,
Nakajima Park gets light creatures
you can walk inside.

❄️ Our take: come before the 25th to get both.

👉 The order that beats the crowds:
